# Compile outputs must be persisted atomically

The Persist stage (database commit) is a single atomic transaction for knowledge model changes; upstream stages (collect, extract) commit incrementally, but only Normalize+Diff+Persist are stored atomically as a unit.

Guarantees data consistency: a compile run either appears entirely or not at all in system history, preventing partial or inconsistent states in the database.
